scope: Cold-mixture outlet pulse with complete detailed chemistry/transport: two grid spacings and one temporal-tolerance halving, each compared with an extended domain.

launches.physics: Full 10-species/29-reaction chemistry, temperature-dependent thermodynamics, multicomponent and Soret transport, viscosity. Small pressure pulse is an initial condition, not a reduced governing model.
launches.boundary_types: Left reservoir of the unperturbed mixture; right extrapolated outflow; slip/adiabatic transverse walls.
